_about: Written 20 Oct 2026, 'The Last Harvest at Penhallow' (3 chapters, 6 planted mistakes, 2 traps). Written by the assistant who knows which kinds of mistake the checks cover, so it is NOT held out. Test run local vs deployed by the user.

planted.description: Iris has green eyes (ch1) but blue eyes (ch3).
Dominic's scar is through his left eyebrow (ch1) but his right eyebrow (ch2).
Mr. Osei died on Sunday and was buried on Tuesday (ch1, ch2) but lifts a crate and winks on Saturday (ch3).
The truck's axle snapped and it 'will never run again', scrapped (ch2) but Dominic loads and starts it for market (ch3).
Iris broke her right wrist, cast for six weeks, no lifting or climbing (ch2) but climbs a ladder with both hands picking apples (ch3).
Iris is twenty-eight (ch1) but 'thirty-three that spring' (ch3), in the same October.

decoys.description: The barn is red when Iris was nine (ch1, ch3 memory) and grey now (ch1, ch2): it was repainted over the years; the red is a memory.
Iris left the valley at twenty-six (ch3 memory) and has been away two years: consistent with twenty-eight.
